changes.editSummary: Seeded the first Health Commons protocol-variant page shape.
changes.rationale: Lock the page, lineage, claim, test-plan, and artifact-manifest architecture before adding canonical sauna content.

changes.rationale: Convert the completed discovery, gap-fill, and synthesis passes into Health Commons pages with strict overclaim guardrails and a PDF workflow that downloads only clearly open-access redistributable files.

changes.editSummary: Expanded sauna source pages and Cloudflare R2 artifact stubs for the canonical dry-sauna evidence set.
changes.rationale: The commons can now represent legally gated PDFs and source artifacts for the canonical sauna pages without committing journal PDFs to Git.

changes.editSummary: Replaced temporary sauna seed content with the canonical Murph Finnish dry-sauna field-test protocol.

changes.editSummary: Simplified canonical sauna page-level citations and fixed artifact generation for source-page snapshots.
changes.rationale: Detailed source attribution now lives in claim sourceKeys and the bibliography page; generated artifact manifests now also include artifact pointers declared directly on source pages so Cloudflare R2 sync sees them.

changes.rationale: Murph now needs a practical operator path for adding article PDFs to Cloudflare R2 without committing them to Git and without bypassing rights review.

changes.editSummary: Renamed the Finnish dry sauna modality into the user-facing dry-sauna experiment family.
changes.rationale: Dry Sauna and Infrared Sauna are easier for users to differentiate than nested sauna/finnish-dry keys, while the parent sauna page still preserves the broad passive-heat family.

changes.editSummary: Expanded the canonical dry-sauna protocol with a much larger structured research base, optional morning blood pressure tracking, and a bibliography-backed evidence map.
changes.rationale: Murph's sauna research corpus is now large enough to expose source-bucket structure, null evidence, and protocol-design guardrails directly on the canonical page instead of relying on a handful of seed citations.
